payload.posture: Read 1 Samuel 28:1–11 as evidence about the Spirit, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states 1 Samuel 28:1–11 identifies a qualified or nonhuman spirit within a scene where it is locally described; the wording centers on “Saul had sent away those who had familiar spirits and the wizards out of the land.” It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Spirit.
